reader_answers.evidence: The next-break helpers are in AdNextHelpers.cs:21-49. The last-break helpers are in AdPastAndSnoozeHelpers.cs:19-30. ad.when is the upcoming seed at AdScheduleWarner.cs:253. ad.duration on the end event is at AdBreakEndScheduler.cs:117. No row takes an argument (BroadcastRow.cs:35).

The scope is required at TwitchAdsApi.cs:65-73 and AdScheduleWarner.cs:154-161. The base sign-in leaves it out (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Identity/TwitchLoginScopes.cs:54-61). The gap is recorded via TwitchTokenResolver.cs:237-265 and MissingScopeRecordingHandler.cs:58-70, then shown with the title 'Twitch permission missing: {scope}' (dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:1123, TwitchGrantGapSource.cs:148). The page indeed gives no grant step.

A null result prints the token as written (AdRows.cs:22-37, BroadcastRow.cs:28). The path-form check takes the else text when the value is unresolved (IfTemplateHelpers.cs:125-159, LogicArguments.cs:31-35). Schedule helpers work in all non-viewer contexts (BroadcastRow.cs:53, TemplateHelperContexts.cs:21-22). Event helpers work only in EventResponse and Pipeline (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:102-106).

The upcoming response fires once at 3 minutes or less, is skipped in the first 10 minutes and is skipped without the scope (AdScheduleWarner.cs:39-42, 154-161, 237-257). The end response carries ad.duration and runs only while live on the same stream (AdBreakEndScheduler.cs:101-122). The timer fallback uses the path-form check (IfTemplateHelpers.cs:145-159).

findings: The page says 'Until the permission is granted, the schedule helpers print as typed' but never says where to grant channel:read:ads, although the Needs attention item for it deep-links to integrations and says 'Grant it on the Integrations page' (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Notifications/Sources/TwitchGrantGapSource.cs:149-154, dashboard/src/i18n/locales/en.json:1125), so a reader whose helpers print as typed cannot fix it from this page.

The page says '{ad.next.duration}, which gives 0s' with no break planned, but the helper prints Twitch's Duration field with no check for a planned break (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/Platform/Templating/Helpers/Broadcast/AdNextHelpers.cs:45-49), so 0s holds only if Twitch reports a duration of 0, which no product source establishes (only the test fixture assumes it, BroadcastHelperFixture.cs:157).
